verdict: Paid ads are not yet live; five launch milestones remain overdue.
narrative: No paid activity has run in the last 28 days — $0 in spend and zero paid leads across Google and Meta — because five pre-launch milestones originally due July 31 and August 1 have not been completed. All engagement this period came from your Google Business Profile, which drove 83 total actions (16 calls, 23 direction requests, 44 website clicks). GBP actions have declined roughly 32% over the last 7 days versus the prior 7, with zero actions recorded in the last three days, a trend we're monitoring closely. The outstanding launch items — stack testing, LSA verification, landing pages, and both ad launches — are the immediate priority and are being resolved this week so paid channels can go live. Once ads are running, you'll begin seeing paid lead volume and a cost-per-lead figure for the first time.
